data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. All other 24 fishers: consider 18 for $8,000 more now than 10, if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-term. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Please state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
